### CVE-2025-14302 — GIGABYTE｜Motherboard - Protection Mechanism Failure
- Assigner: twcert | Published: 2025-12-17 | Updated: 2025-12-17 | Max CVSS: 7
- CWE: CWE-693 CWE-693 Protection Mechanism Failure
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 7 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:P/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.8 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:P/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Certain motherboard models developed by GIGABYTE has a Protection Mechanism Failure vulnerability. Because IOMMU was not properly enabled, unauthenticated physical attackers can use a DMA-capable PCIe device to read and write arbitrary physical memory before the OS kernel and its security features are loaded.

**solutions:** Please update firmware to latest version.

Affected:
- GIGABYTE / intel 600 chipset Motherboard: affected 0
- GIGABYTE / intel 700 chipset Motherboard: affected 0
- GIGABYTE / intel 800 chipset Motherboard: affected 0
- GIGABYTE / AMD 600 chipset motherboard: affected 0
- GIGABYTE / AMD 800 chipset motherboard: affected 0
- GIGABYTE / AMD TRX50 chipset motherboard: affected 0

References:
- https://www.twcert.org.tw/tw/cp-132-10574-ddf09-1.html [third-party-advisory]
- https://www.twcert.org.tw/en/cp-139-10575-e4f41-2.html [third-party-advisory]
- https://www.gigabyte.com/Support/Security?type=1 [vendor-advisory]
